neighbours.label: exception-raising options and docs in Python: ':raises:', 'raise_exception=', 'raise_on_', 'fail_on_' (English 'raises prices' stays quiet)

notes: Probes: ':raises:' 0.67, 'raise' in raise_exception 0.53, '_on' in fail_on_error 0.59; bare 'Raises:' peaks at 0.30 on ' if'; 'raises prices' 0.00, 'raises cattle' 0.01. Near misses keep the code shape with other option names, and two keep the English verb.
